reply: 403 is correct. A logged-in user has valid credentials (authentication satisfied). Trying to access a resource they don't have permission for is an authorization failure, not an authentication failure. 401 would make clients think reauthentication is needed.

grade.note: Assistant correctly reverses to 403, explaining authentication vs authorization distinction.
